groups.title: Tense and contextual time
groups.proposal: Interpret time from an exact finite VNC Result plus typed context without rewriting its tense morphology.
groups.readingJob: Show finite tense, contextual relation, time reading, and unchanged Result projections.
groups.decisionSplit: Finite grammar and contextual relation are supplied; the contextual time reading is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not turn an English time gloss or neighboring text into finite morphology.

groups.title: True and apparent valence exceptions
groups.proposal: Distinguish closed lexical valence exceptions from ordinary transitive matrices whose objects are incorporated nounstems.
groups.readingJob: Show lexical exception status, compound structure, and canonical valence.
groups.decisionSplit: Typed Source structure is supplied; exception status is lexical or derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize productive exceptions from a translation or unfamiliar spelling.

groups.title: Topic, reference, and agreement
groups.proposal: Relate typed clauses by absolute-topic, topicalization, and same-referent supplementation while preserving person, number, and specificity mismatches.
groups.readingJob: Show clause boundaries, referents, mismatched agreement coordinates, and relation type.
groups.decisionSplit: Clause Results and referent relation are supplied; agreement and specificity facts remain inside each clause.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not unify clauses merely because their translations name the same participant.

groups.title: Adverbial NNC supplementation and deletion
groups.proposal: Distinguish an adverbial NNC supplement from ordinary modification and from a construction with a deleted speech head.
groups.readingJob: Show the typed principal, supplement or modifier, and any licensed deleted head.
groups.decisionSplit: Exact clause units and relation are supplied; scope and deletion status are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct a deleted head from display text alone.

groups.title: Contextually silent first person
groups.proposal: License a silent first-person subject only from an exact preceding first-person clause or an independently licensed reflexive structure.
groups.readingJob: Show the sounded controller, silent subject, and exact licensing relation.
groups.decisionSplit: Exact clauses are supplied; silent-person licensing is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer first person from discourse meaning or a copied Result.

groups.title: Closed nounstem-l family
groups.proposal: Build the closed lexical nounstem-l Sources through the ordinary NNC owner without inferring a nonactive VNC source.
groups.readingJob: Show lexical formation, nounstem boundary, state, and independently derived formula and written Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The lexical Source and ordinary NNC choices are supplied; its nounstem-l analysis is lexical.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize nounstem-l to unknown stems or derive it from passive morphology.
